<function name="GetPlayerTrace" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Utility function to quickly generate a trace table that starts at the players view position, and ends `32768` units along a specified direction.

For usage with <page>util.TraceLine</page> and similar functions.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<file line="32-L49">lua/includes/extensions/util.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player the trace should be based on</arg>
		<arg name="dir" type="Vector" default="ply:GetAimVector()">The direction of the trace. By default falls back to the direction the player is looking in.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table{Trace}">The trace data. See <page>Structures/Trace</page></ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the entity's model the local player is looking at to console</description>
	<code>
local tr = util.TraceLine( util.GetPlayerTrace( LocalPlayer() ) )
if IsValid(tr.Entity) then print("I saw a "..tr.Entity:GetModel()) end

local trground = util.TraceLine( util.GetPlayerTrace( LocalPlayer(), Vector(0,0,-1) ) )
if IsValid(trground.Entity) then print("I'm standing on a "..trground.Entity:GetModel()) end
	</code>

</example>
